description: Report which Edgegap API this server talks to, its version, whether it is the local or hosted server, and the guardrails in force: read-only mode, application allowlist, max_duration ceiling, the agent deployment cap, the tag forced onto every deployment, and which tools support dry_run. Also says whether this session has a usable token and, if not, why and how to fix it. Call it first when unsure what this session is allowed to do, before anything billable, or when tool calls fail with a token problem. Makes no API call unless check_token is true, and never shows the token.

check_token.description: Make one read-only API call (list one application) to confirm Edgegap accepts the token. Default false.
